criterion: A test pins that a record from another repository is not parsed
summary: Confirmed in source and by its own audit run: 5 of 5 guards pinned, quoted verbatim. Sizing re-measured in a copy - 4331 bytes against a 4096 bound, no sheddable fields present at HEAD so render returns None, and a 1327-byte line with shed == ['repo'] once repo is put back. Correction 4 verified by substance rather than by reading: the reviewer grepped every record-level journal reader in the shipped source, found exactly three, wrote a genuinely repo-shed record with the pre-fix list and ran each - conformance._windows and read_repo are blind to it, cli._journal_diagnostics read it. One understatement recorded: a repo-shed edit record also fed edit_hook_last_seen, so the loss can flip doctor's missing-edit-hook warning and not only a timestamp. Correction 5 verified as true rather than merely humble: both sides of the class's assertion exclude a repo-shed record, so it is structurally incapable of catching that defect. Staleness flagged: the evidence says 400 tests where HEAD now runs 414 on both interpreters, which is drift from later commits rather than a misstatement.
